newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT - June T-bond on the ropes going into data.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - June T-bond on the ropes going into data.

text.p: U.S. Treasury bond futures started an important week on a quiet but defensive note following a recent series of unsuccessful jabs to the upside, technicians said.
"The market is still under significant negative pressure," said Tim Ransford, technical analyst for Dean Witter. "It has had several opportunities to correct and has squandered them all."
June bond futures have been a poor performer near the weekly pivot point of 107-17, Ransford noted.

Ransford predicted June futures would "slash" through 106-12 on the way to targets at 106-03, 106-00, and a weekly low from July at 105-28. The latter, he said, "is a point the market is gunning for."
Once the goal is achieved, however, there is potential for a healthy retracement bounce, said the technician. "I'm leaving that possibility very much open," Ransford said.
